page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. No notes in the margins. A printed mark (a small dash) stands at the right margin beside the line "in capite de Reprehensione". Signature "Y 2" at the foot.

main_text.l: inexplicabile est, vt exitum interrogato nul-
lum praebeat. quanquam alij τὸ ἄπορον,genus:
alij (vt Hermagoras) speciem fecerunt.
Quomodo tanta vis erat sophisticæ? Quo-
niam (vt Gellius scribit) lex est Dialecticæ
disciplinæ, si de quapiam re quæratur, dispu-
tetúrque, atque ibi quid rogere, tum ne am-
plius quid dicas, quàm id solùm, quod es ro-
gatus,aut aias, aut neges: eámque legem qui
non seruant,& aut aliter quàm funt rogati re-
spondent,exiftimantur rudes indoctíque esse,
neque disputandi morem & confuetudinem
tenere.
Quotuplex istius ἀπόρᾳ[?] siue perplexitatis
vitium est? Multiplex omnino. nä varia Stoici
genera confinxerunt. Cicero quidem in vete-
ri Rhetorico quadruplicem Reprehensionis
modum exponit: sed qui ad hunc duplicem
reuocari debeat. Verba illius hæc sunt:Omnis
argumentatio reprehenditur, si aut ex iis quæ
sumpta sunt non conceditur, (id est negatur)
aliquod vnum pluráve:aut his cócesis,cóple-
xio confici ex his negatur: aut si genus ipsum
argumentationis vitiosum ostenditur, aut si
cótra firmam argumétationem alia æquè fir-
ma,aut firmior ponitur. Nā tertius modus in
primo continetur perspicuè. Quartus autem
ad deliberationes tantummodo pertinet. Sed
tamen tota illa Ciceronis disputatio, quæ est
in capite de Reprehensione lib. de Inuent.r.
diligenter obseruanda est.

page.notes: The Greek word after "istius" is uncertain; it may be ἀπορία or ἄπορα, so it is marked [?]. The first Greek phrase "τὸ ἄπορον" is copied with its accent as printed. The printed mark at the right margin by "lib. de Inuent.r." is a reference or printer's mark, not a note; it is not transcribed. The scan is slightly faded at the right edge, so line-end letters there may be imperfect.
